title: Astronaut Bone Loss Can Reach 30% Before Mars
hook: A Mars mission can cost astronauts 30% of their hip bone density.
closing: Long missions need bone protection because weightlessness quietly weakens the body carrying you home.
question: Would you still go to Mars?

segments.say: Astronauts lose 1.5% of bone density each month. Weightlessness weakens bone faster than rest ever could.
Hip density can fall 2.2% monthly. Weight-bearing bones suffer most when gravity stops loading them.
An unprotected Mars mission could cost 30% of hip density. Exercise and treatment become survival equipment.
